verdict.rationale: Granola is not itself an AI coding agent but a meeting-notes SaaS product, so the axis applies; it documents an official Granola MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools connect to query notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights. This is confirmed by first-party docs and a probe verifying the MCP integration page exists. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification that the MCP server works reliably in practice, and details on setup/auth friction.
